def count_inversions(arr):
    return sum(arr[i] > arr[j] for i in range(len(arr)) for j in range(i + 1, len(arr)))

def find_max_inversions_rotation(arr):
    N = len(arr)
    max_inversions = -1
    min_index = 0
    
    for i in range(N):
        rotated_arr = arr[i:] + arr[:i]
        inversions = count_inversions(rotated_arr)
        if inversions > max_inversions or (inversions == max_inversions and list(rotated_arr) < list(arr[min_index:])):
            max_inversions = inversions
            min_index = i
    
    return min_index, max_inversions

def main():
    T = int(input())
    results = []
    
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input())
        arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
        index, inversions = find_max_inversions_rotation(arr)
        results.append(f"{index} {inversions}")
    
    print("\n".join(results))

main()
